ns2:section.sectionText: Fundamentals of pressurized thermal shock analysis (PTS); relevance of PTS in nuclear vessels safety assessment. Transient and steady thermal analysis. Thermal strain and thermal stress in structures. Structural behaviour of pressurized and thermally loaded cylinders. Basic linear elastic fracture mechnics (LEFM). Definition of stress intensity factors. The superposition principle in LEFM and the wight function method. Crack instability and crack arrest. Numerical simulation of a PTS phenomenon in a realistic accident scenario. Prerequisite: Basic strength of materials. UG 3 hrs; Grad 4. Graduate section will include a project to demonstrate PTS.
